## Description

Select the hardware partner (ESP32-S3 prototype limits: BLE control path, Wi-Fi or phone audio), obtain radio/safety certifications needed per country and classification advice (India CDSCO, UAE) for the intended use (recording accessory, human-approved documentation).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Partner contract and BOM recorded; certification plan with dates.
- [ ] **AC2.** Written classification advice for the final intended use and marketing claims.
- [ ] **AC3.** Go/no-go decision recorded against the phone-capture metrics from P3.

## Definition of Done
